bphs-97:santhanam:ch13:v1-2.exact_text: 1-2. Combinations for Wealth. O excellent of the Brahmins, listen to me, speaking on the effects of Dhan Bhava. If the Lord of Dhan is in Dhan, or is in an angle, or in trine, he will promote one’s wealth (or monetary state). Should he be in Ari/8<sup>th</sup> /12<sup>th</sup> , financial conditions will decline. A benefic in Dhan will give wealth, while a malefic instead will destroy wealth.

bphs-97:santhanam:ch13:v6-7.exact_text: 6-7. Yogas for Poverty. One will be penniless, if the Lord of Dhan Bhava is in an evil Bhava, while the Lord of Labh Bhava is also so placed and Dhan Bhava is occupied by a malefic.
